title: Bug: a bad drag-and-drop into Add Game failed silently
description: handleDroppedURL's FileManager.fileExists guard returned early with zero feedback when a dropped item resolved to a URL but not an actual file on disk (an alias Finder couldn't resolve, some non-file drag source) - the drop visually completed and nothing happened, no error, no explanation. Now sets a real errorMessage on that path.
commit_message: Show a real error when a bad drop resolves to no file
